note: Files identical in every packet are stored under common/; the rest under the packet's name, except that a file whose bytes were already stored for another packet is listed in sameAs (packet path -> stored copy under confirm-packet/). snapshot/ cards are the Git blobs at the revised commit and are not copied; their hashes are in each packet-manifest.json (snapshotBlobs and files).

gzipped.note: Files of 65536 bytes or more are stored gzipped (mtime 0, level 9) with .gz appended; the recorded SHA-256 values are of the uncompressed bytes the reviewer saw.
